## Body

pij directory now prints text by default; use pij directory --json (data.roles[].lineage, live holders have no 'to'). Join with pij-rs --json list (data.seats[]); a dead seat is NOT LISTED. Check each holding's PR with gh pr view N --json state,mergeStateStatus. Release only holdings whose work is finished. A dead holder's role sends already queue and wake the PA, and a same-name revive keeps the holding. Reassigning is pm-001's call. Revived seats keep their old context unless revived --fresh, so check footers for anything over 400k. 07 Nov: 11 holdings on dead seats, all open PRs, none released.
